title: Vehicle Stopped Properties
description: Detects vehicles that have stopped within a defined surveillance zone. Captures vehicle view, tracking identifier, zone information, and vehicle classification details.

vehicle_view.description: View or orientation of the detected vehicle (e.g., front, rear, side).

trackid.description: Unique tracking identifier assigned to the detected vehicle during the analytic session.

zoneid.description: Identifier of the zone where the vehicle was detected as stopped.

type.description: Category or classification of the detected vehicle (e.g., car, truck, bus, two-wheeler).
